profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a focus in machine learning and cyber security. Skilled in C++, Python, Java, and JavaScript. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Stanford University with a concentration in Artificial Intelligence.

positions.title: Travel
positions.description: Traveled around the world with my partner. We visited 20+ countries over 15 months.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working across the machine learning stack, from data management systems to deep learning architecture design, to develop computer vision solutions to run on embedded devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked to develop a security solution to protect web applications from automated attacks.

• Developed cluster management software to synchronize and configure machines transforming web content.
• Worked with the Cloud Engineering team to develop a pipeline to process and visualize data for tens of millions of requests per day.
• Implemented countermeasures designed to stop large scale automated attacks on consumer facing websites

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Worked on web application engineering centered on producing tools for managed service providers by developing API endpoints coupled with Backbone.js single page web applications
• Improved internal web based engineering tools and automated unit tests

company.name: OpenDNS - now a part of Cisco

positions.title: CURIS Research Assistant
positions.description:
Hails: Multi-app Web Platform Framework

• Collaborated with graduate students and Professor David Mazières on the development of a secure web MVC designed for websites running third party apps
• Worked with a team of 4 students to develop web applications using Hails, written in Haskell, while giving feedback to and receiving guidance from the original Hails development team

projects.title: Document Embedding via Recurrent Language Models
projects.description: Document embeddings serve to supply richer semantic content for downstream tasks which require fixed length inputs. We propose a novel unsupervised framework by which to train document vectors by using a modified Recurrent Neural Network Language Model, which we call DRNNLM, incorporating a document vector into the calculation of the hidden state and prediction at each time step. Our goal is to show that this framework can effectively train document vectors to encapsulate semantic content and be used for downstream document classification tasks.

projects.title: JARVIS: Virtual Reality World Builder
projects.description:
• Worked in conjunction with Epic Games to create a Virtual Reality world builder in which the user/designer uses the Oculus Rift and Unreal Engine 4 to build worlds from within virtual reality 
• Prototype for VR build: https://www.unrealengine.com/blog/build-for-vr-in-vr
• Selected as Facebook’s favorite Project at the 2015 Stanford Software Faire
